provenance.note: CURRENCY BOUNDARY: France used the French Franc (FRF) until the Euro became the official currency of account on 1999-01-01 (physical FRF/EUR dual circulation until 2002-02-17, full EUR-only from then on). Because of this, cpiIndex is built CURRENCY-AGNOSTIC: it is a pure price-level index (base 2025=100) constructed backward year-over-year purely from annual inflation RATES (index[y] = index[y+1] / (1 + inflation[y+1])), the same method used in us.json. Years 1980-1998 therefore represent French-Franc-era price levels re-expressed in this abstract 2025=100 index; they are NOT FRF currency amounts and should not be read as franc-denominated prices. Years 1999-2025 are Euro-era. All 46 annual inflation rates (1980-2025) are official OECD-basis annual CPI changes (COICOP 2018 classification, back-cast by OECD/inflationtool.com); none are interpolated or estimated.

provenance.license: Public regulatory data: Livret A rate is set by the French government/Banque de France; republished by Wikipedia, INSEE, and French personal-finance sites (Cercle de l'Epargne, BforBank).
provenance.note: EUR-ONLY SERIES (1999-2025 only), per task instructions, since Livret A balances and rate decisions through this period are Franc-denominated pre-1999 but the series here starts at the Euro-era introduction (1999). Values are day-count-weighted annual averages of the official Livret A nominal interest rate, computed from the full published history of rate-change effective dates (e.g. 1999-08-01: 2.25%, 2000-07-01: 3.00%, 2003-08-01: 2.25%, 2005-08-01: 2.00%, 2006-02-01: 2.25%, 2006-08-01: 2.75%, 2007-08-01: 3.00%, 2008-02-01: 3.50%, 2008-08-01: 4.00%, 2009-02-01: 2.50%, 2009-05-01: 1.75%, 2009-08-01: 1.25%, 2010-08-01: 1.75%, 2011-02-01: 2.00%, 2011-08-01: 2.25%, 2013-02-01: 1.75%, 2013-08-01: 1.25%, 2014-08-01: 1.00%, 2015-08-01: 0.75% (frozen 2016-2019), 2020-02-01: 0.50%, 2022-02-01: 1.00%, 2022-08-01: 2.00%, 2023-02-01: 3.00%, 2025-02-01: 2.40%, 2025-08-01: 1.70%). Cross-checked against INSEE's official published annual averages for 1999-2003 (2.69/2.63/3.00/3.00/2.69) and against France-EcoScan's published averages for 2022-2025 (1.38/2.92/3.00/2.16) -- all independently computed values matched to within rounding. riskFree is set identically to fr_savings (no separate French T-bill series of comparable retail-accessible, continuously-published length was found over 1999-2025; same approach as us.json, which also sets riskFree = us_savings).

provenance.license: Index levels are public historical market data (Euronext Paris CAC 40, a price index without dividends); macrotrends.net, Le Figaro, La Tribune and AFP/BSS are secondary reporters of official Euronext closing levels.
provenance.note: EUR-ONLY SERIES (1999-2025), per task instructions (CAC 40 existed pre-1999 but was FRF-denominated; this series begins at Euro introduction). Year-end (last trading day, typically Dec 29-31) CAC 40 closing level, price-return only (no dividends). For 2023 and 2024, macrotrends' reported closes (7319.76 and not available) were found to be stale/incorrect versus live French financial press, so official year-end closes were cross-verified and corrected using Le Figaro/Les Echos/Tradingsat/La Tribune reporting: 2023 close = 7543.18 (+16.52% YoY, confirmed by multiple French outlets), 2024 close = 7380.74 (-2.15% YoY, confirmed by AFP/Le Figaro), 2025 close = 8149.50 (+10.42% YoY, confirmed by La Tribune/Tradingsat/EY CAC 40 profile). All other years (1999-2022) sourced from macrotrends' annual CAC 40 table, cross-checked for internal consistency between consecutive closes and reported annual % changes; none interpolated or estimated.
